description: Establish the clean baseline on the new B300 instance and download the preview DSpark weights once. Confirm SSM access, ensure no platform-default container is holding GPUs, verify NVMe free space, then download deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark (~167GB SGLang fp8/mxfp4 preview) to NVMe. This single weight copy is reused by both later topologies -- never re-download. History: this preview repo exit(1)'d during platform auto-deploy; downloading manually surfaces the real error (download timeout / disk-full / repo issue), so capture full errors if it fails.
steps: Confirm SSM reachability: `aws ssm describe-instance-information --region us-west-2 --filters Key=InstanceIds,Values=i-0230a688056b553f5 --query InstanceInformationList[0].[PingStatus,AgentVersion]`. Expect Online.

Snapshot current instance state via one send-command batch: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used --format=csv,noheader`, `docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Image}}'`, `df -h /opt/dlami/nvme`, `ls -la /opt/dlami/nvme/models/`, `ls -la /opt/tpot-bench/scripts/`. (Confirmed at plan time: 8 GPUs at 0 MiB, no containers, 27T free, stable-weight dir deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash present, platform compose docker-compose-tp8-b300.yaml present.)

Defensively tear down any platform-default containers even if none appear now (platform may still be deploying): `docker compose -f /opt/tpot-bench/scripts/docker-compose-tp8-b300.yaml down --remove-orphans 2>/dev/null; docker ps -q | xargs -r docker rm -f`. Then re-check `nvidia-smi` shows all 8 cards at 0 MiB before proceeding.

Download preview weights in the background (167GB -- MUST be nohup + logfile, not a blocking send-command). base64-encode a small download script to avoid quoting issues, write it to /opt/dlami/nvme/dl_preview.sh, then run it with nohup writing to /opt/dlami/nvme/dl_preview.log. Script body: `set -euo pipefail; df -h /opt/dlami/nvme; mkdir -p /opt/dlami/nvme/models; pip3 install -q huggingface_hub; export HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT=60; MODEL=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark; DIR=/opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark; python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download('$MODEL', local_dir='$DIR')"; du -sh "$DIR"; echo DOWNLOAD_DONE`.

Poll download progress every few minutes via separate send-commands that `tail -n 40 /opt/dlami/nvme/dl_preview.log` and `du -sh /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark`. Wait until log shows DOWNLOAD_DONE and du is ~167GB.

If the download fails (exit 1, timeout, disk-full, gated/404 repo, missing HF_TOKEN), capture the full tail of dl_preview.log, diagnose the real root cause, and attempt a reasonable fix (retry snapshot_download for resume, set HF_TOKEN if gated, verify repo id). Record the outcome in this feature's findings.
acceptance_criteria: nvidia-smi confirms all 8 GPUs at 0 MiB used (no leftover platform container) before any preview launch.
Directory /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark exists and `du -sh` reports roughly 167GB (weight download complete, config.json + safetensors shards present).
dl_preview.log ends with DOWNLOAD_DONE (or, if it failed, the real error and root-cause analysis are recorded in findings).
verification: SSM send-command running `ls -la /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark && du -sh /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark && tail -n 5 /opt/dlami/nvme/dl_preview.log` returns the shard listing, ~167GB, and DOWNLOAD_DONE.
SSM send-command running `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used --format=csv,noheader` shows all 8 cards at 0 MiB.
findings:
COMPLETED 2026-09-14. All acceptance criteria met.

(1) SSM Online: describe-instance-information returned PingStatus=Online, AgentVersion=3.3.4793.0.

(2) Baseline snapshot: At first check the platform HAD auto-deployed a container `scripts-sglang-tp8-1` (Up ~38s, health: starting, image lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.17-cu130) though GPUs still showed only 4 MiB each (model not yet loaded). NVMe 27T free (28T total, 149G used). /opt/dlami/nvme/models/ contained only the STABLE dir deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash (not our target). /opt/tpot-bench/scripts/ had docker-compose-tp8-b300.yaml.

(3) Defensive teardown: ran `docker compose -f /opt/tpot-bench/scripts/docker-compose-tp8-b300.yaml down --remove-orphans; docker ps -q | xargs -r docker rm -f`. After: docker ps -a empty, all 8 GPUs at 0 MiB. Confirmed clean baseline.

(4) Download: base64-encoded dl_preview.sh (exact script body from steps), decoded to /opt/dlami/nvme/dl_preview.sh on instance, launched with nohup > /opt/dlami/nvme/dl_preview.log 2>&1 &. Backgrounding required (167GB) to avoid SSM invocation timeout; polling done via separate send-commands. IMPORTANT sandbox quirk: local execute_bash tool has a 120s timeout, so do NOT `sleep 180` before a poll -- fire the poll send-command with a short local sleep (~12s) instead.

(5) RESULT: Download SUCCEEDED. The historical exit(1) did NOT reproduce. Repo deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark is PUBLIC -- downloaded unauthenticated (no HF_TOKEN needed; HF only warned about lower rate limits). dl_preview.log ended with `Fetching 74 files: 100%`, `156G`, `DOWNLOAD_DONE`. Final dir: 48 safetensors shards (model-00001..00048-of-00048.safetensors), config.json present, plus README.md/LICENSE/generation_config.json/.gitattributes and encoding/ + inference/ subdirs (74 files total). `du -sh` = 156G (measured on-disk; plan's ~167GB is approximate, 156G is within expected range for this fp8/mxfp4 preview). Download process exited cleanly.

(6) Post-download: all 8 GPUs still at 0 MiB, no containers. Weights at /opt/dlami/nvme/models/deepseek-ai__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark are ready for reuse by BOTH FEAT-002 (TP8) and FEAT-003 (4P4D) -- do NOT re-download.

NOTE for FEAT-002/003: the platform may re-auto-deploy the scripts-sglang-tp8-1 container; re-run the defensive teardown before launching the manual preview server. Booking 5bd1f130 left running per boundaries (no stop/terminate).
